summary: Risk sentiment is broadly bearish: a stronger U.S. dollar, hotter inflation expectations, higher Treasury yields, and renewed rate-hike concerns are pressuring gold and crypto. Bitcoin has fallen below $70,000, but Michaël van de Poppe is contrarian bullish and expects a relief bounce toward $72,000–$74,000 from support; evidence for other requested tokens and new altcoins is insufficient in the available sources.[1][4][7][10]
